spans: ## We changed your 2010 tax return
Your new refund: $812.40
After the fix, the IRS owes you a refund of $812.40.
We found a mistake on your 2010 tax return (Form 1040).
The mistake was in the part about work expenses you paid for yourself (called "Employee Business Expenses").
Read this letter. Then check our changes against your tax return.

**If you agree with our changes:**
- You do not need to do anything.
- You should get your $812.40 refund in 4 to 6 weeks.
- You should get your $812.40 refund in 4 to 6 weeks.
- The one exception: if you owe other taxes or certain debts, we must use your refund to pay those first.
**If you do not agree with our changes:**
- Call us at 1-800-555-0124. We can go over your account with you.
Or write to us.
Fill out the "Contact information" section of this letter, tear it off, and mail it to us. Include any papers that support your side.
- Please contact us within 60 days of the date on this letter (February 9, 2011). If you do, we will undo our change.
F13.note: drops 'in writing': a phone call wouldn't get the change reversed
